title: Netflix NFL Opener In Australia Draws 18.5M Viewers, Extending League’s Muted Start To Season
full_text: Skip to main content Dismiss News Banner Breaking News ‘Widow’s Bay’ & ‘The Pitt’ Take Top Series Emmys As Matthew Rhys & Jean Smart Make History: Full Winners List Read the full story By Dade Hayes Dade Hayes Business Editor @dadehayes More Stories By Dade Chuck Norris, ‘Buffy The Vampire Slayer’s Nicholas Brendon Among Those Skipped By Emmys In Memoriam Emotional Tributes To Catherine O’Hara And Rob Reiner Bookend Emmys In Memoriam Segment Reba McEntire & Sally Field Honor Dolly Parton At Emmys: “If There Are Truly Angels On Earth, We Have Just Lost One” View All September 15, 2026 5:36am A pass play during the San Francisco 49ers-Los Angeles Rams NFL game in Melbourne, Australia. Morgan Hancock/Getty Images Netflix drew an average audience of 18.5 million for its live coverage of the first NFL game played in Australia , according to Nielsen . The viewership of the San Francisco 49ers-L.A. Rams game played in Melbourne equaled that of a game streamed last year from Brazil by YouTube. While retaining audience counts for plenty in today’s media environment, for a juggernaut like the NFL it extends what has been a subdued start to the regular season. The league’s opening-night game last Wednesday on NBC and Peacock fell 11% from last year, averaging 25.1 million viewers. The NFL has been leaning into its activities outside the U.S. in recent years, with global expansion one of the notable media themes heading into 2026. Related Stories News Sally Field Reflects On Filming 'Remarkably Bright Creatures' In Canada: "Let's Keep Our Neighbors Close" -- Emmys Backstage News Emmy Analysis & Scorecards: Apple Breaks Records & Leads Honors With Huge Night For 'Widow's Bay' Globally, the Rams-49ers game pulled in 21.7 million viewers across Netflix’s full scope of 200-plus countries and territories, the NFL said. The non-U.S. audience of 3.2 million for the Australia game marked an improvement over the 1.2 million overseas viewers tuning into the YouTube game. Watch on Deadline Last year, the streaming game was played on a Friday, compared with Thursday this year. The timing of the season kickoff on Wednesday this year, a quirk of the schedule that comes up every now and then, may have contributed to the ratings dip compared with the usual Thursday night kickoff. Matchups also played a role in the ratings drop, with the perennially popular Dallas Cowboys taking on the Philadelphia Eagles on NBC a year ago, compared with this year’s Seattle Seahawks-New England Patriots contest. Although this year was a Super Bowl rematch, last February’s lopsided but workmanlike win by Seattle in the Super Bowl is not fondly recalled by even casual football fans. Ratings for Sunday’s main kickoff to the usual full slate of NFL games, including a marquee prime time matchup between the Cowboys and the New York Giants, have not yet been released. Also to be determined is the tune in for the debut of Monday Night Football, a Taylor Swift-inflected blowout win for the Kansas City Chiefs over the Denver Broncos. More than 340 social impressions and 14.5 million engagements across Netflix and NFL social channels were registered by the 49ers-Rams game, the NFL said. The league noted that it ranks among the most-streamed Thursday NFL games in prime time. Amazon took over exclusive carriage of Thursday night games in 2022. A younger audience also tuned in for the Netflix game, the NFL noted. It averaged 4 million viewers between the ages of 18 and 34, marking the highest level in that demo for a streamed game outside of Christmas. Netflix started airing a Christmas Day doubleheader in 2024, making the broadcasts a centerpiece of the company’s push into advertising, which is now in its fifth year. title: Oldenburg Adds Ned Crowley’s ‘Dead Drop’ to Line Up
full_text: × Skip to main content Full List All of the Winners at the 2026 Emmys close By Scott Roxborough Plus Icon Scott Roxborough Europe Bureau Chief sroxborough Follow Sign Up View All September 15, 2026 3:00am 'Dead Drop' Ned Crowley The Oldenburg Film Festival has made a late edition to its line-up, adding Ned Crowley Dead Drop to its official selection. The film will have its world premiere at Oldenburg, Germany’s leading indie film fest. The high-concept horror thriller, according to the movie’s publicity material, follows a group of eight strangers who „board a freight elevatorn and find themselves trapped in an ever-worsening life-and-death predicament that ultimately reveals they are all linked together in a sinister, supernatural, or even biblical nightmare.” Related Stories TV 'The Test' Season 4 Among Prime Video's New Australian Originals Movies Massih Parsaei's San Sebastian-Bound Debut 'Lovers Sleep Alone' Chronicles a Queer Man in Exile (Exclusive Clip) The low-budget feature is Crowley’s follow up to his supernatural Western Killing Faith (2025) starring Guy Pearce, DeWanda Wise, and Bill Pullman, which has been a major streaming success, reaching number 2 on HBO Max’s worldwide movie charts and hitting number one in several territories, including Argentina and Brazil. Killing Faith got a boost from fan Stephen King, who, shortly after its premiere at Beyond Fest, posted a review on X, calling it “a quasi-supernatural Western that has echoes of Cormac McCarthy.” King ranked it as one of his favorite films of the year. For Dead Drop , Crowley said he decided to shift away from “sweeping landscapes and A-list actors” to “create something equally compelling within the confines of a locked, claustrophobic 15 foot steel box, driven by the performances of relatively unknown actors.” ‘Dead Drop’ Ned Crawley The film features an ensemble cast including Melissa Neal, Daniel Adeosun, Victor Rivera, Christina Tam, Alexandra kate, Roger Ajogbe, John O’Mahony, and Elijah Craft. Dead Drop is Crowley’s third feature as a director after Killing Faith and his 2016 debut Middle Man, a crime comedy starring Jim O’Heir, Andrew J. West, and Josh McDermitt. The 33 rd Oldenburg International Film Festival runs Sept. 16-20. THR

title: ‘The Test’ Season 4 Among Prime Video’s New Australian Originals
full_text: × Skip to main content Full List All of the Winners at the 2026 Emmys close By Abid Rahman Plus Icon Abid Rahman International Editor, Digital gentlemanabroad Follow Sign Up View All September 15, 2026 2:55am 'The Test' Scott Ehler Photography/Amazon MGM Studios Amazon Prime Video has commissioned three new Australian Prime Original docuseries. The streamer has confirmed a fourth season of its popular cricket behind-the-scenes docuseries The Test . The upcoming chapter will follow the Australia mens test cricket team on their packed 2026-27 schedule that includes daunting tours to South Africa, India, the one-off 150th Anniversary Test against England and the 2027 Ashes tour. Season four should be an intriguing watch as the Baggy Greens enter a period of transition, with many legends aging out and attempts to blood younger players proving a struggle thus far, all under the intense scrutiny of a demanding Aussie press and public. Related Stories Movies Massih Parsaei's San Sebastian-Bound Debut 'Lovers Sleep Alone' Chronicles a Queer Man in Exile (Exclusive Clip) Movies Oscars: Bulgaria Picks Cannes Winner 'The Dreamed Adventure' for Best International Feature Race The Test , a co-production between Amazon MGM Studios, Cricket Australia and Whooshka Media, will stream globally but a released date hasn’t been released yet. Prime Video has also commissioned the true crime docuseries, Free Spirits: The Backpacker Poisonings (working title). Per the streamer, the logline for the series reads, “In late 2024, eight young backpackers from around the world including two Australians set off on the adventure of a lifetime through Southeast Asia, chasing freedom, friendship, and self-discovery. They documented everything on their phones: chaotic bus rides, late-night laughs, voice notes home, and joyful selfies. But after a night out in Laos, everything changed. Today, six are dead. Of the two who survived, one was left permanently blind. Told through the backpackers’ own footage, final messages, and intimate testimony from the survivor and the victims’ families, this three-part docuseries reconstructs the events leading up to the tragedy and the search for answers that followed. More than an investigation, it is a powerful coming-of-age story that serves as a cautionary tale about youth, risk, and the pursuit of adventure in an unpredictable world.” Free Spirits comes from Cineflix for Amazon MGM Studios and will also stream globally. ‘Free Spirits: The Backpacker Poisonings’ Cineflix/Amazon MGM Studios Madness of Three is Prime Video’s third original Aussie commission, and another true crime docuseries. The project, which was produced by Blackfella Films for Amazon MGM Studios, takes indepth look at the 2022 Wieambilla shootings, that became a global news story. A logline for the series reads, “[the docuseries covers] the shocking 2022 murders in Wieambilla, Queensland, when three locals, two of them former teachers, left two police officers and an innocent neighbour dead. With unprecedented and exclusive access, the five-part docuseries explores the conspiracy, delusion and online influence that drove Nathaniel, Stacey and Gareth Train to violence and asks how is it possible to go down the rabbit hole and never come back.” ‘Madness of Three’ Blackfella Films/Amazon MGM Studios “We strongly believe that to be successful globally, you need to be successful locally”, said Sarah Christie, head of Australian and New Zealand originals at Amazon MGM Studios, in a statement. “These new commissions reflect our continued dedication to telling compelling Australian stories that matter – from the sporting moments that unite us, to true crime cases that gripped us locally and made headlines internationally. Australia is home to extraordinary creative talent and we are proud to be investing in series that not only resonate with Australian audiences but captivate viewers around the world. These are powerful, authentic stories told with the depth and insight they deserve.” The three original commissions continue Prime Video’s investment in Australia in recent years, and the company says that it has commissions 34 Aussie original sinces 2019, that span the gamut of television production. Although the company has adopted an Australia-first approach in terms of the appeal of its originals, there have been notable breakout global hits, including the Jacob Elordi-starring limited series The Narrow Road to the Deep North and the black comedy series Deadloch . title: Massih Parsaei’s San Sebastian-Bound Debut ‘Lovers Sleep Alone’ Chronicles a Queer Man in Exile (Exclusive Clip)
full_text: × Skip to main content Full List All of the Winners at the 2026 Emmys close By Lily Ford Plus Icon Lily Ford @lilyfordtweets Follow Sign Up View All September 15, 2026 2:30am 'Lovers Sleep Alone' San Sebastian Film Festival The Hollywood Reporter can unveil an exclusive clip from Massih Parsaei’s Lovers Sleep Alone , set to premiere at the upcoming San Sebastian Film Festival . The Iranian filmmaker is competing in the New Directors selection with the Berlin-set drama, focused on an isolated lead character played by Pooyesh Frozandeh in the actor’s first feature film role. With a screenplay from Parsaei and Hanna Thomschke, the tender Lovers Sleep Alone premieres on Sept. 25 at the Spanish film festival and follows Iman, who has built his life in Berlin around absence. “From his family, from Iran, from being known,” continues a plot synopsis. “He drifts through the city, chasing closeness and solitude. Day in, night out, he works as a caregiver for an old man and at a truck wash. He fills the silence with invented stories and a man he meets for sex in a park. On his endless paths through the city, the fragments from the lives of other passersby drifts alongside him.” Related Stories Movies Oscars: Bulgaria Picks Cannes Winner 'The Dreamed Adventure' for Best International Feature Race TV 'Murdoch Mysteries' Producer Christina Jennings Raises Alarm on Canadian Sovereignty: "We're a Bit Under Siege" “When his cousin Maneli visits from Tehran,” the synopsis continues, “what Iman left behind quietly finds its way back to him.” The debut filmmaker said about his personal ties to the project: “This film comes out of my own experience of leaving, and of everything that time doesn’t fix, even long after you’ve arrived. Iman is a queer man in exile, on the margins in more than one way. He stands between the images of desire he grew up with and the ones that are only beginning to form, ones he is still learning to trust.” “I know that in-between from my own life, and I’ve rarely seen it on screen. I didn’t want to explain him, or account for how his past shaped the person he is now. Not his suffering, not a story about being saved. I wanted to show his days, and the state underneath them. Iman is the passer-by we don’t pass by, the one we stay with,” Parsaei added. The clip released to THR , which you can watch below, shows a car window looking out onto the gloomy, bustling streets of the German capital as a passerby ponders over whether fear can often feel like an illness. Lovers Sleep Alone is a Film Five GmbH Production, in co-production with the Konrad Wolf Film University of Babelsberg. The project was funded by Medienboard Berlin-Brandenburg & Rundfunk Berlin Brandenburg as part of the Leuchtstoff initiative, and supported by the Young Talent Foundation Berlin. Co-starring with Frozandeh is Ava Darvishi, an Iranian actor, theatre maker and playback theatre practitioner based in Ghent, Belgium, as well as Marcel Kohler, a German stage and screen actor based in Berlin. title: ‘Charlie’s Angels’ Stars Jaclyn Smith, Kate Jackson and Cheryl Ladd Reunite at 2026 Emmys to Honor Farrah Fawcett: “Shiniest Angel of All”
full_text: × Skip to main content Full List All of the Winners at the 2026 Emmys close By McKinley Franklin Plus Icon McKinley Franklin View All September 15, 2026 12:21am Jaclyn Smith, Kate Jackson and Cheryl Ladd speak on stage during the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards held at the Peacock Theater on September 14, 2026. Trae Patton/NBC via Getty Images The stars of Charlie’s Angels reconvened at the 2026 Emmys , where they paid homage to the late Farrah Fawcett . Kate Jackson , Cheryl Ladd and Jaclyn Smith were onsite to celebrate the show’s 50th anniversary , and present the Emmy for best drama series, which ultimately went to The Pitt . “It’s an honor to be here tonight to present the Emmy for drama series and to celebrate the 50th anniversary of Charlie’s Angels ,” Jackson began, before Smith paid tribute to Fawcett. “I would like to acknowledge someone not standing with us tonight, and that’s my friend Farrah Fawcett. As I’ve said many times, charisma doesn’t need a second season,” Smith said, a reference to her starring turn in only the first season of Charlie’s Angels . “As I said many times, she’s here with us in everyone’s collective memory.” Related Stories Critic's Notebook The Michael J. Fox Tribute, Mariska Hargitay Singing, and Other Highs and Lows From an Ungainly, Ill-Flowing Emmys Telecast TV Inside Zendaya's 2026 Emmys: Date Night With Tom Holland, Surprise Dinner Invite and That Pixie Cut Jackson continued of their co-star, “Farrah was the shiniest angel of all, and she was loved by millions of people all over the world, and she still is today. And they’ll never forget her and neither will we, and I’m sure you won’t either.” “And her iconic poster lives in the minds, and the garages, of many a man,” Ladd added before they announced The Pitt as the best drama Emmy winner. Charlie’s Angels debuted on Sept. 22, 1976, created by Ivan Goff and Ben Roberts. Jackson, Smith and Fawcett starred in season one as three investigators who worked for their boss, Charlie. Fawcett departed as the first installment, and Ladd joined the cast. Heading into this year’s Emmys , The Pitt led the nominees with a total of 25 nods, followed by Hacks with 24 (which set a record for a comedy series nominations in a single year) and Widow’s Bay with 19 . The 78th Emmy Awards telecast live from the Peacock Theater at L.A. Live in Los Angeles Monday night on NBC, streaming on Peacock. Mariska Hargitay served as the night’s host, after last week winning two Emmys at the Creative Arts ceremony. See the full 2026 Emmys winners list and all the dazzling red carpet looks here . THR
